name: Spherical Harmonic Volume Shading
definition: A method to compute shading including the max function effect without repeated 3D Fourier transforms by approximating the illumination and max functions using spherical harmonics, allowing the shading equation to be expressed as a convolution in spherical coordinates.
summary: Spherical Harmonic Volume Shading computes diffuse illumination in Fourier Volume Rendering by approximating shading with spherical harmonics, enabling interactive relighting via simple coefficient updates without recomputing Fourier transforms.
